focus: Harrat volcanic fields (Rahat, Lunayyir, Hutaymah already partly covered), Red Sea / Farasan coral reefs and islands (Jazan), Jazan salt dome and Jabal Fayfa, Asir highland escarpment and Precambrian Arabian Shield outcrops, Al-Bahah granite and Wadi landscapes, Rub' al Khali dunes and sabkhas (Najran/Eastern), Tuwaiq and Qassim sandstone sections (Saq, Tabuk, Qasim formations), Northern Borders and Al-Jawf Palaeozoic outcrops, sinkholes and karst (Dahl Hit, Eastern Province).
